blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden shop counter with decorative front paneling, designed with flat base edges that sit directly on the floor. On top of the desk lies a dark draped cloth holding a collection of magical curiosities: a large purple crystal ball on a golden stand, an animal skull with curved horns, clusters of faceted pink and teal crystals, a golden armillary sphere on a pedestal, two rolled scrolls with gold ferrules, a small lidded wooden trunk, and a dark carved stone slab. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and finished in a clean hand-painted video game art style with warm brown wood, metallic gold accents, and vibrant magical highlights.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden tabletop where the left two-thirds are covered by an irregular dark cloth holding a large circular purple sphere, a light-colored skull, pink and blue crystal clusters, a golden multi-ring sphere, two pink scroll cases, and a rectangular box, leaving the wooden boards on the right bare.
blind.height_vs_figure: The counter table stands roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.8 ft tall, with the tallest objects reaching about 3.8 ft), with a length roughly equal to the height of the figure (around 5.5 to 6 ft wide).
